messages:
maria: Morning passoff — quick summary of what happened overnight and current status. tl;dr: embeddings autoscaler started thrashing around 02:14 UTC, we saw ~15–30m periods of elevated 429s for long-seq embedding requests from a handful of customers. Primary mitigation: scaled dedicated embed pool + temporary route to small-quant model. Customer impact limited but visible in SLO dashboards.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: embeddings-autoscaler-thrash @ 2026-06-12T02:14:07Z — pages: 3 — Sev: P2 — channels: eng-oncall, incidents. Link: https://incident.redwood/INC-4521 (auto-summary).

aj: Thanks Maria — can you confirm primary/secondary for next 12h? I'm on later shift from 16:00 UTC and can be secondary.

maria: I'm primary until 12:00 UTC. @aj you're secondary after 16:00 UTC as you said; @greg will cover the 12:00–16:00 UTC window.

greg: Got it. quick notes on what we changed: autoscaler config had a minReplicas=0 -> this hit a pathological oscillation due to short-lived low-rate traffic patterns + aggressive scale-down TTL (30s). I bumped minReplicas=2 and scaleDownDelay=120s as a stopgap.

maria: Action timeline (short):
- 02:14 — first pager, error pattern: OOM/eviction logs on embed-worker nodes, autoscaler up/down repeatedly.
- 02:22 — added temporary route for long-seq embeddings to quant-small model (reduces mem footprint).
- 02:35 — scaledDedicatedPool +3 replicas in eu-west to absorb burst.
- 03:05 — apply autoscaler config changes: minReplicas=2, scaleDownDelay=120s.
- 03:40 — rate of 429s dropped to baseline, but some customers still saw elevated p95.

beth-cs: customers notified? I put an outbound note in Zendesk for two affected accounts (acct-phi and acct-echo). Both say degraded performance but no data loss. I offered the small-quant route as short-term mitigation.

maria: Good — Beth: please keep me posted on any escalation. Also flagged for a follow-up communication after we complete postmortem.

oncall-bot: DEPLOY: autoscaler-config-bump applied by maria @ 2026-06-12T03:05:12Z — diff: `minReplicas: 0 -> 2`, `scaleDownDelay: 30s -> 120s`.

greg: Evidence snapshot (logs):
```
embed-worker-1 | 2026-06-12T02:12:35Z OOMKill: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: requested 2.1G > available 1.8G
embed-autoscaler | 2026-06-12T02:14:18Z scaleDown pod embed-6 -> terminated
embed-autoscaler | 2026-06-12T02:14:50Z scaleUp pod embed-7 -> running
```

maria: Current status: traffic stable, error-rate returned to near-normal, still seeing occasional p95 spikes for very long sequences (>1024 tokens) routed to hosted small-quant fallback. No open pages right now.

aj: Next steps / post-incident items for morning triage:
- SRE: run a canary that replays long-seq embedding workload against autoscaler changes to ensure no oscillation. (owner: greg)
- Runtime: evaluate memory guards in embed-worker to avoid OOMs and add clearer OOM->retry mapping (owner: eng-runtime).
- DevEx: add a runbook entry for long-seq embedding fallbacks and a knob to quickly route to quant-small (owner: maria).
- CS: follow up customers, collect example payloads for failed requests (owner: beth-cs).

greg: I'll add a test in the autoscaler integration suite to simulate small sustained bursts and validate scaleDownDelay behavior. ETA EOD.

sre-lead: Please also add a dashboard panel for "embed autoscaler oscillation" — show replica count + pod create/delete rate + 429 rate side-by-side. Makes debugging faster.

maria: Runbook pointers: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/embed-autoscaler-thrash (temp draft) — includes rollback commands and a one-liner to fallback routing: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/route -d '{"model":"embed-quant-small","selector":"long-seq"}'`

aj: For handoff: I'm attaching a quick checklist for the secondary oncall: verify pool replica counts in eu-west and us-west, check Redis eviction metrics (sometimes upstream cache pressure correlates), confirm CS queue is up to date.

maria: Any coverage gaps? Greg — can you confirm you can handle the first hour after you take over? We want someone with cluster access present until autoscaler tests pass.

greg: I can cover that window. I'll keep my pager on for the first 60–90m and run the canary tests.

beth-cs: I'll sync with acct-phi tomorrow 09:00 PST and offer to route heavier batches to batch-ingest as a temporary mitigation if they need throughput.

maria: OK. no further pages for now. leaving playbooks and links in the thread. If anything changes ping @channel.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=maria until 12:00 UTC, secondary=greg 12:00–16:00 UTC, secondary2=aj 16:00–00:00 UTC. Reminder: rotation-coverage doc: https://internal.redwood/oncall-rotations

aj: Thanks — I'll take over at 16:00. final note: please attach any sample payloads to the thread so we can replay.

maria: Will upload one sample later today. signing off — maria (primary)
